newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO electricity output hits winter high.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO electricity output hits winter high.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc, Japan's largest power utility, said on Tuesday that its electricity output hit an all-time winter high of 48.55 million kilowatts (kw) at 11.00 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Monday.
The temperature at that time in the Tokyo region was 3.6 degrees celsius, TEPCO said in a statement.
TEPCO's previous record for winter electricity output was 48.50 million kilowatts (kw), set on January 22.
In the Tokyo region, use of electricity is greater during the summer months.
TEPCO's all time high is 59.40 million kw, marked on July 18, 1996.
